purpose_ru: Квалификация сторонних наборов данных по четырём строго независимым показателям у одного и того же человека: текущая поведенческая вовлечённость, непосредственно предъявленное узнавание, прямой тест порядка событий и отсроченное воспоминание. Отсутствие ощущения времени — отдельный самоотчёт, не синоним амнезии или прекращения физического времени.

required_axes.definition: Task-event logged present-moment behavioral engagement under a priori criteria. Generic attention tests or eventual task participation are not equivalent to real-time awareness; none can directly certify consciousness.
Direct recognition of the same recently shown items measured immediately at encoding or with a specified short delay, not merely free recall or a different test.
Direct ordering/judgment of two or more experimentally encountered stimulus events by participants, not event dating, duration estimation, retrospective timing, or calendar ordering of study visits.
After a documented delay, within-person item/episode recall of the same stimuli, with item identity separated from ordering; delayed order alone is an imperfect proxy.

access_rule: An author's claim that data are available on request or that an OSF page exists does NOT verify accessible file bytes, rights to use data, or availability of all required participant-level variables.

candidates.title: Multidimensional assessment of time perception along the continuum of Alzheimer’s Disease and evidence of alterations in subjective cognitive decline
candidates.population: 17 healthy controls, 16 subjective cognitive decline, 17 MCI, 13 Alzheimer's disease; one cohort underwent many temporal and neuropsychological tasks

online_engagement.evidence: Visual search/Trail Making/digit span and task performance; no independently time-locked proof of conscious engagement at each stimulus

immediate_recognition.evidence: RAVLT and visual recall include immediate MEMORY measures; they are not identical to direct item recognition during temporal trials

temporal_order.evidence: Temporal collocation/dating of public events and duration tasks; not a verified same-stimulus paired event-order judgment

delayed_recall.evidence: Published neuropsychological battery includes RAVLT and Babcock story immediate/delayed recall; not verified matched stimulus to timing tasks

candidates.notes: Best clinical multidimensional temporal experience source; does not satisfy strict four-axis matching from paper description; author request is justified but not sent.
candidates.request_target: Corresponding author Alice Teghil; email published in the paper, no email action taken

candidates.title: Impaired retention is responsible for temporal order memory deficits in mild cognitive impairment
candidates.population: 25 younger controls, 34 older controls, 32 MCI; immediate/delayed sequence and recognition study

online_engagement.evidence: Task completion not an independently registered sustained engagement check

immediate_recognition.evidence: Recognition phase is reported; its immediacy relative to each stimulus not established as direct immediate recognition

temporal_order.evidence: Explicit sequence reconstruction task for 3-, 4-, 5-item sequences

delayed_recall.evidence: Study phase includes delayed recall at 10 minutes, including sequence; same-item delayed identity data not independently verified

candidates.notes: High-priority mechanistic comparator because title explicitly argues retention explanation for temporal-order errors; challenge to a unique timelessness theory.

candidates.title: Knowledge-based intervention improves older adult recognition memory for novel activity, but not event segmentation or temporal order memory
candidates.population: 80 older adults without stated Alzheimer's/MCI diagnostic cohort; pre/post event segmentation, recognition and ordering tasks

online_engagement.evidence: Behavioral segmentation during watched videos; does not prove real-time subjective awareness

immediate_recognition.evidence: 2AFC recognition after watching the video; exact immediate timing and raw records not inspected

temporal_order.evidence: 66 2AFC image-order trials following the viewing task

delayed_recall.evidence: Free recall is reported; same-item delayed episodic recall after a documented interval not established

candidates.notes: Especially valuable published negative intervention result: knowledge improved recognition, not event segmentation/order. Candidate for open methods replication when OSF data access and license are verified.

candidates.title: Reliable detection and continuous monitoring of memory dysfunction in mild cognitive impairment and healthy aging through adaptive computational phenotyping
candidates.population: 24 MCI and 27 control participants; repeated weekly online learning/recall across up to one year

online_engagement.evidence: Participation and response-time/accuracy can proxy engagement, but not independent consciousness signal

immediate_recognition.evidence: Adaptive learning/recall tasks; exact same-item immediate recognition field not verified

temporal_order.evidence: Chronological order of weekly lessons is a covariate, not direct within-trial temporal order judgment

delayed_recall.evidence: Memory retention/forgetting over timed delays central to task; underlying fields not inspected

candidates.notes: Promising for MCI forgetting model only. Do not confuse temporal sequence of visits with experimental time-order perception.

candidates.title: Subjective time perception in dementia: a behavioural and neuroanatomical analysis
candidates.population: Dementia subtypes studied; sample not extracted in this audit

online_engagement.evidence: Task and cognition measures cannot be presumed to include independent sustained engagement checks

immediate_recognition.evidence: Not verified from full instrument list

temporal_order.evidence: Direct same-item temporal order not verified

candidates.notes: Data specifically withheld publicly to protect participants; code publicly linked, not a data license.

candidates.title: Cognitive connectome and MCI conversion dataset
candidates.population: 822 healthy older adults at baseline; 115 MCI conversions at follow-up, as reported by dataset record

online_engagement.evidence: Digit span, processing-speed measures and neuropsych scores; not time-locked current engagement

immediate_recognition.evidence: FCSRT/ROCF may capture immediate memory, but no direct matched recognition verified

temporal_order.evidence: No direct event-order judgment listed in public 20-variable description

delayed_recall.evidence: ROCF/FCSRT memory included; exact delay variable metadata restricted

candidates.notes: Although public landing page exists, Zenodo explicitly labels attached files RESTRICTED. Cannot download or use as open data.

decision_rule.ready_if: At least one legally and ethically authorized independently sourced individual-level dataset (same participant) contains all four DIRECT verified task columns with documented matching of stimuli, delay and event timestamps, plus nonleaking split and source checksums; any missing gate blocks R3 full analysis.
decision_rule.missing_proxy_policy: Never substitute temporal collocation of news events, simple recall, prospective duration, task attendance, or calendar of visits for a direct event-order or current-engagement measurement.
decision_rule.controls: Participant-level disjoint split, preregistered analysis, comparators for attention/sensory impairment, language, medications and task difficulty. Medical diagnosis from source never inferred by JANUS.
decision_rule.no_posthoc: No selecting thresholds, columns, cohorts or task combinations after measuring target outcomes.
decision_rule.protected_ledger: No patient microdata, identifiers, interviews or raw logs to public GitHub; persist only a source/permission manifest and nonidentifying checksums after approval.

requested_but_not_sent.purpose: Ask for data dictionary, per-task participant linking, temporal collocation trials, RAVLT immediate/delayed recall and attention task measures; verify participant-level research-only sharing terms and independent reanalysis rights.
